title: PTCG Card Data - Cleaned, Bilingual & Engine-Cross-Validated

resources.description: Corrected EN card data, one row per attack/ability (2,022 rows / 1,267 unique cards).
Cleaned JP card data, one row per attack/ability (2,022 rows / 1,267 unique cards).
Bilingual card-level index, one row per unique Card ID (1,267 rows).
What was found wrong in the official files and exactly what was corrected.

One row per unique card (1,267 rows), merging real battle-engine ground truth (HP, retreat cost, ex/megaEx/tera/aceSpec flags, evolves_from, real attack_ids) with the CSV's bilingual/expansion fields.
One row per real attack (1,556 rows), keyed by the real engine attack_id, with structured energy costs and integer damage.
One row per real named card effect (426 rows) -- a new entity split out from Attack for the first time.
One row per real, reconstructed evolution chain (461 rows), Basic through Stage2.

Real cross-validation of the CSV against the battle engine's own structured data, two real accuracy bugs found and fixed, real descriptive statistics, plus a v3 pass: re-verified referential integrity, real effect-tag enrichment, and a real 60-game card-usage dataset.

One row per real attack (1,556 rows), real keyword-matched boolean flags (16 categories: status conditions, coin flips, energy discard, bench damage, etc.) derived from each attack's real printed effect text.

One row per real named ability (426 rows), real keyword-matched trigger-timing flags (once-per-turn, passive/static, on-play, on-damaged, on-knock-out, on-attack) derived from each ability's real printed text.

One row per unique card in the real 60-card decklist (15 rows), real usage counts (played/attacked-with/evolved-into/energy-attached) and real win rate when used, aggregated from 60 real self-play games through the actual battle engine.
One row per (card, attack) pair actually used across 60 real self-play games, with real times-used and real total/average damage dealt.
